correctness.rationale: For every integer n>=3 and real height, scale, rotation, explicit lateral facet altitude yields S=2nR^2 sin(beta)(c+sqrt(y^2+a^2)); mixed planar area integration yields V=nR^3 y sin(beta)(c+a/3), a in [0,1-c]. Sign of d_y log(S^3/V^2) equals sign of t^2-2ct-3a^2 with a unique crossing, yielding global height optimum. At the optimized height the relative-twist derivative has sign 9ac-t(t+4c)<0 for c>=1/2 and 0<=a<=1-c<=c, t>=2c. Hence sharp equality cases and constant follow without finite tests. The independent hull checker passed 5,582 assertions; finite checks corroborate formulas only.

value.rationale: This solves a natural joint extremal problem for the complete family of regular parallel two-ring hulls rather than a special arbitrary parameter value: the sharp isoperimetric constant, all equality geometries, exact optimal height and many-sided cylinder limit are established. Its strict separation from the edge-uniform height for all n>=4 identifies a meaningful geometric tradeoff between equal edges and surface efficiency.
